title: Enterprise App & Service Principal Governance (App Registrations, API Permissions)
author_notes: Effort tier: T3 (govern OAuth apps/service principals/app registrations, consent, API permissions, and secret/cert expiry in Entra; conditional logic, security risk from over-permissioned apps).
hook: Find the risky OAuth apps and over-permissioned service principals hiding in your tenant
problem: Every SaaS integration and internal app leaves behind an enterprise app, a service principal, and a set of API permissions — and over time they pile up: apps nobody owns, dangerous consented permissions, and app secrets/certs quietly expiring or lingering forever. Attackers love them. This solution gives you a repeatable way to govern enterprise apps and service principals in Microsoft Entra: inventory them, review consent and API permissions for over-privilege, control user consent, and manage secret/certificate hygiene.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the Entra app model (app registrations vs. enterprise apps/service principals), delegated vs. application permissions and admin consent, the over-permission and consent-phishing risk, and secret/certificate lifecycle.

Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Entra ID, appropriate admin roles, a consent policy decision, an app inventory approach, a pilot scope) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.

Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: inventory enterprise apps/service principals, review API permissions and consents for over-privilege, configure the user-consent policy (and admin-consent workflow), remediate risky grants, manage secret/cert expiry, validate, pilot, then expand.

5 PowerShell scripts — enterprise-app/service-principal + permission discovery, risky-consent and expiring-secret validation, an app-governance and over-permission report, safe remediation of risky grants, and a governance-scope group builder.
Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.
short: A repeatable way to govern enterprise apps and service principals in Microsoft Entra — inventory them, review consent and API permissions for over-privilege, control user consent, and manage secret/certificate hygiene. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
